breakdown.description: Counter-flow flame requires opposing inlet velocities; both inlets set to +x
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the core inconsistency. For a counter-flow flame with inlets at x=0 and x=0.02, the velocities must be opposing. The agent repeated the user's error by setting both the fuel inlet velocity and the air inlet velocity to '+0.1 m/s in x-direction'. The correct configuration, as shown in the ground truth, requires the air inlet velocity to be '-0.1 m/s'.
